images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated modular environment asset reference for Blender modeling of a Chinese xianxia open-world game. Input image is MATERIAL AND STYLE inspiration only, not the whole environment to reproduce. Create ONE coherent, buildable sect approach ROAD MODULE extracted from this visual style, no mountain environment. DESIGN: a straight elongated rectangular blue-gray ancient stone path about 4m wide by 11m long (not dimension labels). South/front: a low flat 6m-long paved approach, 0.2m thick. Middle: exactly SIX broad evenly spaced shallow stone steps rise northward over about 2m run to a 1.2m-high upper landing. North/rear: a flat 3m-long higher rectangular paved landing, supported by visibly coursed weathered stone side walls, no hollow space below. All the same width, no bends. Walkable large irregular fitted blue-gray flagstones, restrained chips and cracks and moss only in joints, stable flat walking surfaces, a few tiny grasses along margins, not rubble. EXACTLY TWO matching modest Chinese stone lanterns, one at west edge and one at east edge of upper landing just behind stair top. Lanterns have square stone pedestal, slender square shaft, enclosed square chamber with simple square opening, small Chinese sloped cap; NO glowing flame, no Japanese torii. EXACTLY ONE irregular upright stone waymarker at the EAST/right edge near the south low road entrance, with one shallow abstract spiritual emblem, not readable text. Keep props outside clear central walking lane. No railings, no bridge, no trees, no gate, no extra lanterns, no characters, no smoke or atmospheric fog. Freestanding game-environment module on a seamless neutral-light-gray studio background, fully exposed perimeter foundation profile, soft diffuse lighting, subtle contact shadow, sharp geometric and material details, realistic stylized 3D asset quality with elegant ancient Chinese fantasy restraint. Palette gray-blue slate, muted moss green, weathered gray lantern stone. One whole module in frame with ample margins, landscape 16:9, single view, no labels, watermarks, UI, diagrams or collage. CAMERA: Front-right three-quarter from SOUTHEAST, elevation 30 degrees, long lens. Lower road nearest bottom-left, steps ascend away toward upper-right into landing. Show whole module and both long edges.
